u.0.1.31.t: A built-in Tracker, LYNX Model, JSFX, Linux arm64, two projects side by side and much more
u.0.1.31.s: LYNX SHARE 0.1.31 adds a built-in Tracker with tracker module import, LYNX Model (physical models of mallet instruments), JSFX scripts, Linux arm64 builds, a welcome card and a start page, Search actions for every command, two projects side by side with copy and paste between them, a Sections lane, a Chord lane with Smart Tempo, Track versions, automation write modes, Capture automation and modulators for any knob, FL Studio Mobile .flm export, Live's rack devices inline with a Macro Map and Solo / Cue, ARA on a mixer insert, a plugin pack of 39 plugins (also LV2 on Linux, and a 20 MB .7z on Windows) and fixes for around 30 GitHub issues.
u.0.1.31.n0: Tracker: View › Tracker (Shift+F7) shows a pattern's notes as rows and channels and edits them the tracker way, and tracker modules (.mod, .xm, .s3m, .it) open with their samples, patterns and tempo.
u.0.1.31.n1: LYNX Model: a physical-model instrument with marimba, vibraphone, xylophone, glockenspiel, tubular bells and kalimba.
u.0.1.31.n2: JSFX: REAPER's effect and instrument scripts run in mixer slots and as instruments on every system, and 31 free scripts come with LYNX SHARE.
u.0.1.31.n3: Linux arm64: AppImage and tar.gz builds for a Raspberry Pi 4 / 5 with a 64-bit OS and other arm64 machines.
u.0.1.31.n4: A welcome that fits you: the first start asks where you are coming from and sets up the matching layout; later starts open on a start page with your recent projects. Search actions (? or Ctrl+Shift+Y) finds any command, and File › Open in new window opens a second project with copy and paste between the windows.
u.0.1.31.n5: Song structure: a Sections lane for whole song parts, a Chord lane with Smart Tempo, Track versions, and tracks you can hide or deactivate.
u.0.1.31.n6: Automation and modulation: write modes Touch, Latch and Write, Capture automation, and modulators (LFO, envelope follower, ADSR, steps, random, macro, keytrack, velocity) for any knob, also on third-party plugins.
u.0.1.31.n7: Clip-launch layout: Live's rack devices inline in the Device View with a Macro Map mode, and Live's Solo / Cue. Simple layout: Duck under, Reverb and Echo sends, sections and time signature changes.
u.0.1.31.n8: Formats and plugins: FL Studio Mobile .flm export, Zipped loop package and Collect all and save, tracks imported from another project, ARA on a mixer insert, and a plugin pack of 39 plugins, also as LV2 on Linux and as a 20 MB .7z on Windows.
u.0.1.31.b0: Performance, measured again against FL Studio 2026 on one Windows PC: Thief plays with {{PERF_THIEF_CPU}} % of one core (FL Studio: {{PERF_THIEF_CPU_FL}} %) and Exoplanet with {{PERF_EXO_CPU}} % (FL Studio: {{PERF_EXO_CPU_FL}} %). Safe overloads lets go as soon as the song stops.
u.0.1.31.b1: FL parity: eight more Kilohearts laws and the Nonlinear Filter (Kilohearts Essentials 5.88 → 6.85, Nonlinear Filter 4.62 → 9.43); FL's slide law, Sytrus, Ogun and SimSynth velocity, Harmor automation and multi-target automation clips; FL's automation clip rows in the Channel rack.
u.0.1.31.b2: From contributors: a gear that hides the header of docked windows (PRs #248 and #256) and windows that take the size of the tab they show (PR #259) by FKHR26; Patcher cables into a Formula Controller (PR #257) by codewithamoako.
u.0.1.31.f0: Around 30 GitHub issues: #193, #218, #222, #225–#244, #246, #247 and #249–#254, among them #233 (start offline), #243 (ARA on a mixer insert), #251 (save with all media), #253 (FL's send automation) and #254 (horizontal mouse wheel).
u.0.1.31.k0: JSFX scripts with their own @gfx display show LYNX SHARE's slider panel instead. Linux arm64 has no plugin pack yet. #199, #255 and #258 were not reproduced; 0.1.31 adds checks for them.
